snippet.title: Dual Protocol: The Case of Eva & Miles | Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The time has come to unearth the truths hidden in the shadows. Dual Protocol: The Case of Eva & Miles is out now on Steam.

In this noir world shaped by asymmetric co-op mechanics, you must take on the role of either Eva or Miles, piece together clues, and solve complex puzzles. You have no choice but to communicate and work together; because the secrets of this case are too deep for a single detective to solve. The investigation files are now open. Find your partner and dive into the case.

Play Now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4660280/DUAL_PROTOCOL_The_Case_of_Eva__Miles/

Join the Rock Paper Publisher Official Discord: https://discord.gg/DN4ebsYBgH
Follow us on Twitter/X: https://x.com/RockPaperPub
Follow us on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/developer/rockpaperpublisher
